question: Can /Oe /Og allocate a plain auto to BX, and what source shape gives it? Positive control S13:384C DrawMower (worker resF): exact only when the final position is written to new locals (h = x + left; v = y + top; call(h, v, ...)). x then lives in BX (no call inside its live range, frame 8 = frame word + h/v homes) and y in SI; with the in-place form (x += left; y += top; call(x, y, ...)) x and y take SI/DI (push di added), the frame shrinks to 4 and the function grows by 2 bytes.
